{{Top|leg}}
The '''grava berry''' was a type of fruit found on the moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] made an intoxicating drink from fermented grava berries. They introduced members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], including [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], to the drink during the celebrations following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
